findings.frozenDecision: 新易盛 Research selection because broad optical opportunity timing was adverse despite realized earnings conversion and clear peer asymmetry

laterFundamentalCheck.description: 2025Q1 revenue RMB4.052bn +264.13%, attributable profit RMB1.573bn +384.54%, CFO +20.45%; company attributed the growth to data-center demand. The frozen company-specific earnings engine continued to accelerate after cutoff.

findings.label: timing_gate_missed_idiosyncratic_multi_engine
findings.generalLesson: A broad sector basket can be adverse while one company has a distinct, already-realized earnings engine and materially better valuation/revision asymmetry. Sector timing should remain a risk signal, but it should not be an unconditional veto when a stricter company-engine timing test is satisfied.

findings.frozenDecision: 紫金矿业 High-priority selection over 山东黄金/山金国际

laterFundamentalCheck.description: Post-cutoff Q1 results showed strong earnings conversion across the peer set: 紫金 profit +62.39%, 山东黄金 +46.62%, 山金国际 +37.91%. The gold opportunity was fundamentally valid; the 60d cross-sectional ranking was mixed rather than a clear company-fundamental failure.

findings.label: opportunity_right_selection_mixed
findings.generalLesson: Do not infer a new rule from one control-ranking miss when the selected company beats the benchmark and fundamentals remain strong. Event purity versus valuation may need more evidence before any future change.

commonPattern: company-specific earnings conversion was already realized before reveal
company had clear cross-sectional revision/valuation asymmetry

replicatedFailureClass.implication: Sufficient evidence now exists to design a new general company-engine timing override. Q1/Q2 outcomes may motivate the mechanism but may not validate the next version.
